title: Ay Mere Naazon ke
body:
ay mere naazon ke paale khaak udaane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad maa karbala jayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
kund khanjar se teri sheh rag bachane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad maa karbala jayegi
<<DIVIDER>>
saath tere kaun hoga ek bas umme rabab
tere rukh par ek chullu khoon ka hoga hijaab
qabre asghar pusht e qaima par banane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye suraj chupa chuka ho dhal chuka ho shab mein shaam
roz e ashoora qayamat ho chuki ho iqtetaam
ek yateemi ko tere laashe pe laane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tera hamshakle payambar apna dil thaame huwe
khoon mein tar seene pe apne haath ko rakhe huwe
mil ke tere saath akbar ko uthaane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
jayega abbas tera hurr ke istebaal ko
dar guzar kar dega tu mujrim ke sab aamaal ko
uske ek rumaal maathe par sajane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya sitam dekhegi zainab teri khwahar pur malaal
ghurbate sajjad ki dega gawahi zuljalaal
kar ke himmat us ko sholon se bachane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
boli abid maa jahan hogi teri majlis bapa
nauha o matam ki goonjegi kahin bhi jab sada
behte aansu apne daaman mein uthane ke liye
chod kar apni lehad...
ay mere naazon ke...
author: Abid
